name: Chula Vista bank robber, 2019 (convicted; silhouette only)
depiction: The man sentenced in federal court in June 2020 to 57 months for the 14 October 2019 Chase Bank robbery in Chula Vista, California, after which witnesses said he rode off on a Lime scooter. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option): no face, no features; plain dark jacket. Never named on screen. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS. No weapon shown (he claimed to have one; none is drawn).
